remarks: Experience refined waterfront living in this exceptional custom-built five-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offering panoramic views and direct access to the East Niagara River. Set on over half an acre with beautifully landscaped grounds, this mostly brick home combines timeless elegance, superior craftsmanship, and remarkable pride of ownership throughout. A covered front patio welcomes you into a spacious foyer where stunning water views immediately capture attention. The dramatic two-story living room showcases floor-to-ceiling windows and a striking three-sided fireplace, creating an impressive yet inviting gathering space. Hardwood flooring, crown molding, and abundant natural light enhance the elegant formal dining room, which seamlessly opens to the solarium. Designed for both comfort and entertaining, the family room features a beamed ceiling, custom built-in cabinetry and shelving, and direct access to the year-round sunroom. The eat-in kitchen is beautifully appointed with granite countertops, a breakfast bar, recessed lighting, built-in refrigerator and microwave, convection oven range, ceramic tile flooring, and custom cabinetry with crown molding. A private office and convenient half bath complete the main level. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers breathtaking river views, dual closets including a walk-in, and a luxurious ensuite bath featuring ceramic tile flooring, dual granite vanity, and oversized tiled shower. Four additional bedrooms and a second-floor laundry room with included washer and dryer provide  convenience. The finished basement rec room with wet bar adds additional living and entertaining space, while thoughtful amenities such as six-panel wood doors, central vacuum, two furnaces,  two central air units installed 2026, and a secondary basement egress enhance everyday living. With river views from nearly every room, this extraordinary waterfront property offers a rare opportunity to enjoy luxury, comfort, and spectacular natural beauty in one remarkable home.
